issues.description: The UML/problem statement and the template declare Farm.singFarmSongVerse as a private method, while the solution implements it as protected. This visibility mismatch between the specification/template (private) and the solution (protected) is a structural inconsistency that can confuse students about the intended visibility and access level of the helper method and may affect subclassing or test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse method from protected to private to match the UML/template, or update the UML/problem statement and template to declare singFarmSongVerse as protected if broader accessibility is intended. Ensure the chosen visibility is used uniformly across problem text, template, and solution.
